Taylor R: Quick follow-up from the allocator retro: propose a compact lease handshake so orch keeps topology+global safety and scaler manages short-lived prewarm/active leases. Goal: reduce race windows.

Isha N: Can you sketch states and who finally evicts?

Taylor R: Scaler lease lifecycle: NONE -> REQUESTED -> PREWARM -> ACTIVE -> RELEASE_PENDING. Orch node lifecycle: FREE -> RESERVED -> RETIRING. Orch makes final eviction decisions; scaler may tag requests with preempt_priority.

Ravi P: We should return admission_status in RequestLease: {GRANT, SOFT_THROTTLE, QUEUE_BURST, DENY} plus reason_code (e.g., "headroom_low"). Scaler can fallback_model() or reduce_batch().

Kim W: Observability: emit lease_id and correlation timestamps (req, grant, prewarm_done, active, release) + decision_rationale (short text) and assigned_node. Console needs to map lease -> GPU telemetry.

Isha N: Drain edge: client holds KV cache during release. Propose Release(lease_id,expected_release_ts) -> {ACK, ACK_GRACE_MS, FORCE_REVOKE}. FORCE_REVOKE emits kv_evict metric and triggers routing fallback. Enforce tenant-level max_grace_ms.

Ravi P: To avoid flapping, add probe_cooldown_seconds (default 45s) and failed_prewarm_backoff_ms. Orch can suggest_backoff_ms on denials.

Taylor R: Minimal RPC sketch: RequestLease(tenant_id,demand_est,preempt_priority) -> {status,lease_id,ttl_ms,admission_status,reason_code,assigned_node}; KeepAlive(lease_id)->{status,new_ttl_ms}; Release(lease_id,expected_release_ts)->{status,grace_ms}; OrchEvents(stream)->{lease_granted,lease_revoked,headroom_update}.

orch-bot: autoscaler-dev: canary of "lease-handshake-tidy" succeeded :white_check_mark:

Kim W: I'll add lease traces to Console mocks. Isha, can you write a unit test that fuzzes simultaneous RequestLease calls? Ravi, can you run a contested-headroom sim?

Isha N: On it.

Ravi P: Yup, will run sim next week.

Taylor R: I'll draft the short RFC with proto + state diagrams and include config knobs. Target review by EOW. Thanks! :thumbsup:
